title: Test Garden
tagline: Catch falling stars in a calm little garden.
shortDescription: Fly a small bee around a garden and catch the stars before the timer runs out.
longDescription: Test Garden is the fixture the AI Kids Games website tests use for its Community games shelf. You fly a small bee around a garden and catch as many stars as you can in one minute. Nothing is lost if you miss; the round simply ends and shows your score.
features: Plays with keyboard, mouse, touch or gamepad
Remembers your best score on this device
One self-contained HTML file that works offline
contentNotes: Gentle arcade play with no fighting or scary content. The best score saves in this browser.

quickStart: Fly with the arrow keys, a gamepad stick, or hold your finger where you want to go.
Catch as many stars as you can before the time runs out.
howToPlay: Fly with WASD or the arrow keys, a gamepad's left stick or d-pad, or hold the mouse or a finger where you want to go.
Escape or P pauses; gamepad A or Start presses the buttons in menus.

originality: This fixture is the AI Kids Games starter game, renamed for the website tests. It uses no other companies’ names, characters, art or music.
